name: Orlando Sentinel editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Orlando Sentinel Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). Under a 2022 Tribune Publishing policy it no longer endorses for president, governor or U.S. Senate. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/orlando-sentinel-media-bias.

name: League of Women Voters of Florida (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that calls itself 'a nonpartisan, activist, grassroots organization that believes voters should play a critical role in democracy' (https://lwvfl.org/about-us/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Florida AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation that says 'We work to provide better lives for all workers, members or not, through political and legislative action, grassroots mobilization and education' (https://flaflcio.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Florida Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; backs its general-election nominees and opposes Amendment 3.

name: Republican Party of Florida
lean_basis: Official state party organization; backs its general-election nominees and supports Amendments 1 and 3.

name: Equality Florida Action PAC
lean_basis: LGBTQ civil-rights PAC of Equality Florida, whose stated mission is 'to empower and uplift the LGBTQ community through advocacy, education, and support' (https://www.eqfl.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Orange County Classroom Teachers Association
lean_basis: Teachers' union for Orange County Public Schools that offers members 'A Voice On The Job' (https://orangecta.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: U.S. Rep. Maxwell Frost (FL-10)
lean_basis: Democratic member of Congress for most of central Orange County since 2023.

name: State Rep. Anna Eskamani (HD-42)
lean_basis: Democratic state representative for HD 42, described by Orlando Weekly as 'progressive'; term-limited in 2026.

name: Orange County Mayor Jerry Demings
lean_basis: Term-limited Orange County mayor; a Democrat in an officially nonpartisan office.

name: Orlando Mayor Buddy Dyer
lean_basis: Mayor of Orlando since 2003, an officially nonpartisan office; a Democrat.

name: Former Orlando Mayor Glenda Hood
lean_basis: Mayor of Orlando 1992 to 2003; listed as a Republican in the endorsement roundup.
